title: French forces rescue downed pilot
description: DJIBOUTI - French and U.S. forces conducted Tactical Recovery of Aircraft and Personnel during Alligator Dagger Dec. 19, 2017. Alligator Dagger combat rehearsal increases U.S. and French military efficiency to better respond to crises, ranging from humanitarian assistance and disaster relief missions to combat operations in 5th Fleet area of operations. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Sgt. Jessica Y. Lucio)
